overview: A California Lottery simulator that generates Quick Pick tickets and runs draws until all 6 numbers match, showing how many tries it took.
features: Quick Pick button generates 6 unique random numbers from 1–49
Run Simulation draws until all 6 numbers match your ticket
Displays number of tries it took to find a match
Shows your ticket and winning numbers side by side with match highlights
New Quick Pick clears results and resets the simulation
